title: NeakGuard
welcomeText: Some files in Telegram pretend to be pictures or PDFs but are really programs that can harm your computer. NeakGuard helps find these files.
guardWelcome: A guardian for the files you download from Telegram
lessonTitle: This is what a disguised file looks like
antivirusNote: NeakGuard is not an antivirus. Always keep Microsoft Defender on.
caught: NeakGuard caught it and moved it to Quarantine
cannotOpen: You can no longer open it by accident.
onlyFolder: NeakGuard will only watch this folder
folderTitle: Where does Telegram save your files?
folderText: We found the folder where Telegram Desktop saves your files.
folderMissing: We could not find your Telegram folder
waitTitle: Wait a few seconds before you open a file
waitText: NeakGuard checks every new file before it can be opened. If you open one too soon, Windows may say the file is being used by another process. Wait a few seconds and try again.
windowsOnly: Install NeakGuard on Windows to start protecting your Telegram folder.
stopped: NeakGuard has stopped watching your Telegram folder. New files are not being held, so they can be opened before they are checked.
quarantineText: These files look disguised. NeakGuard moved them away so you cannot open them.
quarantineStopped: These files are still kept in Quarantine.
quarantineListError: NeakGuard could not read the list of files in Quarantine just now. It will try again.
emptyText: When NeakGuard finds a disguised file, it moves it away and shows it here. You can close this window. NeakGuard will keep protecting you.
emptyStopped: No files are in Quarantine. Start protecting again to check new files in your Telegram folder.
errorAdvice: Press “Start protecting again”. If it still does not work, restart your computer.
actionError: NeakGuard could not complete this action
actionAdvice: Try again. Show details if you need help.
restoreText: This file is suspicious. Restore it only if you are sure it came from someone you trust. It will return to your Telegram folder.
holdTitle: Files that cannot be opened yet
holdText: NeakGuard keeps these files closed until it has checked them. If Windows says a file is being used by another process, this is why.
holdSuspicious: Suspicious · NeakGuard is moving it away. It stays closed until then.
holdUnprotected: NeakGuard could not keep this file closed. Another program can open it.
holdOpening: Your choice is saved. Opening soon…
holdGap: NeakGuard closes a new file as soon as Telegram finishes saving it. A very short gap remains before that happens, so this lowers the risk but is not a guarantee.
openAnywayText: NeakGuard could not finish checking this file. Opening it is your decision. It does not mean the file is safe. Choose this only if you know who sent it and you were expecting it.
reasonEncrypted: It is password-protected, so NeakGuard cannot look inside.
reasonUnsupported: NeakGuard cannot check this kind of file.
reasonNested: It contains another archive that NeakGuard did not open.
reasonFailed: NeakGuard could not read this file.
reasonMemory: The check needed too much memory.
reasonCpu: The check used too much processor time.
reasonTooLarge: It is too large for NeakGuard to check.
